about.title:
For the love
of cats.
about.description: Kitten Rescue CA’s mission is to connect cats and kittens with safe, loving indoor homes where they are cherished for a lifetime. We promote responsible adoption rooted in compassion, respect, and a commitment to each cat’s health and well-being. If an adopter can no longer provide care, we welcome the cat back—because our commitment doesn’t end at adoption.
about.signoff:
A loving home for life.
A commitment that lasts.

closing.text:
One small paw.
A whole lot of love.
